newsitem.title: USA: Cox Radio says purchases 3 radio stations.
newsitem.headline: Cox Radio says purchases 3 radio stations.

text.p: Cox Radio Inc said Wednesday it has signed a definitive agreement to purchase three radio stations in San Antonio, Texas, from KISS Radio, an affiliate of Rusk Corp, for $30 million and non-compete agreements.
The three stations are KISS-FM and DSMG-FM, the second and fifth ranked English language stations in San Antonio, and KLUP-AM, the third ranked AM station in the market.
This transaction will make Cox the largest radio operator in San Antonio with four FM and two AM stations.
Robert Neil, Cox's President and Chief Executive Officer, said the new acquisitions provide the company with "opportunities to expand operating margins through top-line growth and cost savings."
Neil concluded, "We remain committed to increasing shareholder value through internal growth, as well as through acquisitions which complement our diversified portfolio of stations."
Cox owns, operates and provides sales and marketing for 50 stations in 12 markets.
